trigger: The initial development-only HPO candidates were materially poor for useful open-set recognition: across completed width-0.1 candidates, known acceptance at the preregistered <=5% unknown-FPIR operating constraint was zero despite nontrivial known top-1 scores. The declared compact matrix remains in progress; this addendum activates a face-pretrained host reference and fixed-teacher student investigation.
platform: Mac host training/evaluation only; no Windows training and no claim of Nicla fit for the teacher.
branch: Public five-known SurvFace K01-K05 benchmark; no personal-photo roster.

teacher.name: OpenCV Zoo SFace MobileFaceNet, December 2021 ONNX

crop_input_contract.teacher_feature_call: OpenCV FaceRecognizerSF.feature on crop with bbox=None; SFace Zoo wrapper explicitly supports this no-bbox path
crop_input_contract.normalization: performed by OpenCV FaceRecognizerSF implementation; do not pre-normalize the uint8 BGR crop
crop_input_contract.alignment: not applied in the primary full-crop benchmark because C supplies no five landmarks

canonical_aligned_diagnostic.detector_input: BGR8 crop at native 96x96; fixed model supports this detector-size setting
canonical_aligned_diagnostic.alignment: FaceRecognizerSF.alignCrop from YuNet box plus five landmarks to 112x112, then FaceRecognizerSF.feature
canonical_aligned_diagnostic.coverage_rule: report all rows, detected rows, exactly-one-face rows, and recognition metrics conditional on exactly one detection; do not impute missing alignments

model_license_record.repository_directory_license: Apache-2.0 is stated for all files in the SFace model directory
model_license_record.exact_training_dataset_for_this_ONNX: not identified by the model README or exact-weight metadata
model_license_record.maintainer_provenance_status: unresolved; OpenCV Zoo issue 313 was open when checked on 2026-10-29 and asks which datasets produced the exact 2021dec weights and whether dataset-derived terms apply
model_license_record.use_classification: host-only research diagnostic in this study; not a deployable or redistributable model recommendation until exact checkpoint/data provenance is clarified

teacher.pretraining_exposure: External identities/corpora are not declared for the exact exported checkpoint; roster-overlap exclusion cannot be certified. This uncertainty is retained in every teacher/student result.

student.source_architecture: Reference-compatible Edge Impulse grayscale MobileNetV1 alpha 0.1 and 0.25 at 96x96, initialized from verified study checkpoints; one shared fixed SFace teacher across all roots.
student.output: 64-D embedding, L2-normalized only in gallery/scoring code; no classifier logits in the student graph.
student.training_data: SurvFace train known rows plus the same permitted unknown_train identities already declared in D_MATRIX_v1; no stopping/calibration/development/final images used for gradient updates.
student.target: SFace crop-route embeddings from the fixed teacher, precomputed for training images; distillation loss matches within-batch pairwise cosine-similarity matrices, leaving target/student embedding dimensions independent.
student.batching: Frozen balanced 24-image batches, four images per K01-K05 plus four unknown images sampled from distinct unknown_train identities; 15 steps/epoch and 360 presentations/epoch.
student.augmentation: Only training rows: same deterministic mild_gray_v1 transform as D_MATRIX_v1; teacher targets remain fixed from the unaugmented source crop.

search.checkpoint_stopping: student-vs-teacher pairwise cosine-matrix MSE on the SurvFace stopping role; patience 3, select lowest MSE
search.candidate_selection: fit root-specific open-set threshold on known threshold_calibration plus identity-disjoint unknown_calibration; choose by development correct-known-acceptance at <=5% unknown FPIR, then development macro known identification, then lower learning rate

student.evaluation: Host SFace and every ten-root student: training-only gallery templates; model-specific thresholds from permitted calibration roles; development selection; final roles remain sealed until all compact and teacher/student artifacts, galleries, calibration, and selection records are frozen.
exports_per_student_root: full-integer INT8 TFLite embedding calibrated from permitted training-role representative images
curve, selected epoch, sample presentations, steps, elapsed compute time, hashes, model-specific calibration
student.selection_policy: Evaluate the same B-derived quality/diversity and uniform matched gallery candidates defined in D_MATRIX_v1; retain difficult evaluation rows and report gallery counts, uncertainty/coverage, and float/INT8 score/decision differences.
